newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end down on excess funds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end down on excess funds.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates closed lower on Sunday amid excess liquidity and are likely to open steady on Monday, dealers said.
Onvernight funds were initially traded at three percent but tumbled near close to two percent, one dealer said.
With excess liquidity in the market, a low borrowing demand and no major outflows due, the rates are likely to remain steady around current levels on Monday, the dealer said.
